quantities: n_e, T_e profiles; electron distribution constraints
method: For calibrated profiles, compute profile summaries and gradients. For calibrated raw spectra, fit a non-relativistic Gaussian Doppler profile with linear background and Gaussian instrument-width deconvolution to estimate electron temperature.
caveat: The raw-spectrum fit is scoped to non-collective, non-relativistic Maxwellian scattering and a Gaussian instrument response. It does not infer density from spectral amplitude; calibrated profile and single-band power density workflows remain separate.
implementation_status: Implemented calibrated-profile workflow plus scoped raw-spectrum electron-temperature fit; overall analysis remains incomplete

input_specs.name: radius_m
input_specs.description: Unique radial coordinate of calibrated Thomson-scattering profile samples.

input_specs.name: density_m3
input_specs.description: Calibrated electron-density profile; same length and order as radius_m.

input_specs.name: temperature_ev
input_specs.description: Calibrated electron-temperature profile; same length and order as radius_m.

input_specs.name: major_radius_m
input_specs.description: Optional positive major radius; enables approximate circular large-aspect-ratio volume-weighted averages.

output_specs.name: density_gradient_m-4
output_specs.description: Numerical radial derivative of electron density.

output_specs.name: temperature_gradient_eV_m-1
output_specs.description: Numerical radial derivative of electron temperature.

output_specs.name: summary
output_specs.description: Peak locations, line averages, and optional approximate volume averages.

assumptions: Inputs are calibrated radial profiles, not raw detector counts or uncalibrated spectra.
Radius is a one-dimensional unique coordinate in metres; samples are sorted internally.
Volume averages use circular, large-aspect-ratio weighting proportional to minor radius and are not equilibrium reconstruction.
preprocessing: Validate finite values, matching lengths, unique radii, non-negative density/temperature and optional uncertainties; sort all profile channels consistently.
execution_contract.algorithm: Two explicitly separated paths: calibrated profile summaries/gradients; and raw-spectrum Gaussian Doppler fitting with instrumental-width deconvolution to estimate electron temperature. The separate single-band scattered-power helper estimates density only when optical power and geometry are calibrated.
execution_contract.uncertainty_model: Raw-spectrum temperature uncertainty is local covariance-based and excludes uncertainty in laser wavelength, scattering angle, and instrumental width. Optional independent uncertainties for the calibrated scattered-power density relation are propagated to first order; profile pointwise uncertainties are preserved but not propagated through gradients, extrema, or averages.
limitations: Power-based density helper requires calibrated collected power, laser power, interaction length, scattering geometry, collection solid angle and optical efficiency.
Single-band power relation neglects spectral-response integration, stray-light subtraction and relativistic spectral-shape effects.
Numerical gradients can amplify measurement noise; use appropriate smoothing only with a justified noise model.
Raw-spectrum fit uses a Gaussian non-relativistic Maxwellian approximation and requires a known Gaussian instrumental width.
Raw-spectrum fit does not infer density from fitted amplitude; absolute density requires a separately calibrated power/throughput model.
Scattered-power density uncertainty propagation assumes independent input uncertainties and excludes covariance and model/calibration discrepancy.
execution_contract.note: Overall analysis remains incomplete: the scoped raw-spectrum temperature fit is available, but density inversion from spectral amplitude and more general collective/relativistic/non-Maxwellian models are not implemented.
